style_prompt: Create production-ready gameplay UI surfaces for a warm, cozy Cat 2048 mobile game. Match a soft Japanese watercolor picture-book aesthetic with subtle paper grain, hand-painted honey wood, warm cream, pale apricot, and restrained warm-brown edge accents. Matte surfaces, soft upper-left light, gentle lower-right depth, clean mobile readability. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, cats, characters, objects, yarn, fabric, plants, room scenery, checkerboard pattern, photorealism, glossy plastic, neon, heavy black outlines, or cropped edges.

assets.prompt: Exactly one centered empty rounded-square game-board cell on a transparent canvas. Warm cream handmade paper inset with very subtle pale-apricot watercolor variation, a thin soft warm-brown inner edge, and a restrained lower-right contact shadow. Broad simple surface designed to repeat sixteen times without visual noise. The cell occupies about 88 percent of the square canvas. No paw print, icon, symbol, illustration, corner ornament, outer frame, or content inside the cell.

A clean square top-down honey-colored wooden game-board base with softly rounded outer corners. The center is one uninterrupted pale honey-wood surface where the game will overlay its own 4 by 4 cells later. Use quiet hand-painted horizontal wood grain, a slim layered wooden rim, two tiny carved paw accents near opposite outer corners, and a very soft inset shadow around the usable center. Keep the center flat, bright, and low contrast. CRITICAL: do not draw any grid, cells, slots, squares, checker pattern, central ornament, yarn, cloth, props, or scene background. The board fills the entire square image edge to edge.
